parameters.name: ClusterIds
parameters.description: A list of cluster IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The type of the service. Valid values:

- `ServiceEntry`: a service registered in the Service Mesh by a service entry.

- `Kubernetes`: a service registered in a Kubernetes cluster on the data plane.
